# Embedded emissions cannot be calculated: CN code missing

The ruleset requires three inputs before any calculation. One is missing.

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in the table | "steel goods" (no CN code) | ❌ Missing |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Listed in table |
| (c) Quantity in tonnes | 3,000 t | ✅ Provided |

The SEE is selected jointly by CN code and country. For India, the table has four goods with different default values (2.53 to 4.32 tCO2e/t). "Steel goods" doesn't identify which one applies, so the ruleset doesn't allow picking or averaging one.

## Results by CN code

Once you confirm the CN code, the result is:

| CN code | Good | SEE (India, tCO2e/t) | Embedded emissions for 3,000 t |
|---|---|---|---|
| 7201 | Pig iron and spiegeleisen | 2.53 | 7,590.00 tCO2e |
| 7206 10 00 | Ingots, iron/non-alloy steel | 2.64 | 7,920.00 tCO2e |
| 7207 11 90 | Semi-finished products, iron/non-alloy steel | 4.32 | 12,960.00 tCO2e |
| 7214 20 00 | Bars and rods, with indentations | 4.27 | 12,810.00 tCO2e |

These figures depend on the CN code. They are not a declared result.

## Next step

Please provide the CN code of the goods. If the 3,000 t covers more than one CN code, give the tonnage for each code so each line can be calculated and totalled.
